ITEM 1 | Pile of small orange-red pieces, roughly cylindrical to tapered strips about 4-6 cm long and 1-1.5 cm thick, glossy with a slight sheen, some with lightly darker edges, smooth skin-like surface, arranged in a loose cluster on the upper-left part of a pale blue plate, covering roughly 20% of the plate | 110
ITEM 2 | Whole round orange-colored citrus-like fruit about 7 cm in diameter, bright orange with slightly pitted matte peel, small dark stem nub at top, sitting on the lower-left of the pale blue plate | 150
ITEM 3 | Whole green-yellow pear-shaped fruit about 7 cm across and 7.5 cm tall, mottled green with yellowish tones, slightly rough skin, small brown stem at top, sitting on the lower-right of the pale blue plate | 160
